qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

VQp6ZD1D0780o7H79faZ7A.zh: 剛果民主共和國於4/2正式宣布結束國家公共衛生緊急狀態。ACDC報告自2024年1月迄2026年3月,該國26省累計報告近16萬例個案,至少有2,267例死亡,其中3萬7,000例確診。此波疫情流行株為Ib型病毒,當局加強疫情監測與擴大高風險族群之疫苗接種,疫情於2025年高峰期單週報告約2,400例,迄2026年4月約170例/週,降幅逾90%。 厄瓜多報告首例Ib型境外移入確診病例,近期有旅遊史,該國已發布警報並向PAHO申請首批疫苗,目前尚無社區傳播風險,將持續加強接觸者追蹤及疫情監測。 巴基斯坦南部信德省海爾布爾縣報告首起Ib型本土院內群聚事件。該地區自3月中旬起持續出現多起疑/確定病例,包括新生兒感染,迄已通報至少7例新生兒病例,其中至少4例確定病例死亡,惟死者亦多具早產、營養不良及體重過輕等病史。當局調查醫院未確實消毒嬰兒保溫箱,導致交叉感染所致,已關閉新生兒加護病房,並啟動接觸者追蹤。另周邊蘇庫爾縣亦有24例疑病例調查中。
VQp6ZD1D0780o7H79faZ7A.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo officially declared the end of its national public health emergency on 2 April. Africa CDC reports that from January 2024 to March 2026, 26 provinces of the country cumulatively reported nearly 160,000 cases and at least 2,267 deaths, of which 37,000 were confirmed. The epidemic strain is clade Ib virus. Authorities have strengthened outbreak surveillance and expanded vaccination of high-risk groups. Weekly reports peaked at about 2,400 cases in 2025 and had fallen to about 170 per week by April 2026, a decline of more than 90%. Ecuador has reported its first imported confirmed clade Ib case; the patient had a recent travel history. The country has issued an alert and applied to PAHO for its first batch of vaccines. There is currently no risk of community transmission, and contact tracing and outbreak surveillance will continue to be strengthened. In Khairpur District, Sindh Province, Pakistan, the first locally acquired clade Ib hospital cluster has been reported. Since mid-March, multiple suspected and confirmed cases have continued to occur in the area, including neonatal infections; at least 7 neonatal cases have been reported, of which at least 4 confirmed cases died. Most of the deceased also had histories of premature birth, malnutrition and low birth weight. Authorities' investigation found that hospital infant incubators were not properly disinfected, leading to cross-infection; the neonatal intensive care unit has been closed and contact tracing initiated. In addition, 24 suspected cases are under investigation in neighbouring Sukkur District.

2N_1D47wGZbEvl2y-Uw-qQ.zh: 厄瓜多今年截至6/1報告771例病例,為去(2024)年同期3倍,並高於去年全年病例數,年齡層主要分佈為20-49歲,以中部瓜亞斯省190例為最多,其次為西部馬納比省178例。另今年5月該國亞馬遜地區原住民社區亦爆發疫情,造成8名兒童死亡。
2N_1D47wGZbEvl2y-Uw-qQ.en: Ecuador reported 771 cases as of 1 June this year, three times the same period last year and more than the full-year total for last year. Most cases are among people aged 20–49. Guayas Province in central Ecuador has the most, with 190 cases, followed by Manabí Province in the west with 178. In May this year, an outbreak also occurred in Indigenous communities in the Amazon region, causing the deaths of 8 children.

k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.zh: PAHO於5/31發布百日咳流病警報,美洲7國病例數呈上升趨勢,其中,以美國逾1萬例病例及5例死亡最為嚴峻,餘有巴西/墨西哥/厄瓜多/祕魯/哥倫比亞/巴拉圭,病例數在37-1,634例間。該地區於2012年病例數達高峰後,持續下降,惟於2023年開始上升,去年報告4.4萬例,病例數增加與新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下降相關,PAHO呼籲各國加強監測及加強疫苗接種等措施。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/19-25)通報2,660例,較前1週2,299例增加360餘例,持續創2018年以來新高,新增病例數以新潟縣(148)為多,其次為兵庫縣(139)。今年迄今已累計逾2.2萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,專家表示此次疫情嚴峻與易感性族群增加相關,由於疫情期間防護措施,導致對多種呼吸道傳染病免疫力下降,且抗藥性菌株於去年秋天以來持續傳播。今年報告2例未達接種月齡之新生兒死亡病例,且此次疫情集中於10多歲青少年族群,建議常與家中嬰幼兒接觸之家庭成員接種疫苗。
k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至第20週累計221例病例(89例死亡),今年病例數約為去年同期27例之8倍,分布於巴西、哥倫比亞、秘魯、玻利維亞及厄瓜多,去年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟今年已傳播至前揭地區以外之巴西聖保羅州及哥倫比亞托利馬省,且以未接種疫苗個案為多,評估美洲地區(尤其流行國家)風險為高。
5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.en: Americas regional update: as of week 20 this year, 221 cases (89 deaths) have been reported cumulatively. This year's case count is about eight times the 27 cases reported in the same period last year. Cases are distributed in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador. Last year's cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but this year the disease has spread beyond those areas, to São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia, and most cases were unvaccinated. The risk for the Americas, especially in endemic countries, is assessed as high.

qka4XggefJqyqzeRk7T_0w.zh: 厄瓜多疫情更新,2024年累計報告6萬餘例病例及76例死亡,病例數高於2023年2萬餘例病例,今年迄今病例分布以中部納波省(899例)及東部奧雷亞納省(626例)為多。 祕魯疫情更新,該國今年迄今累計報告7,800餘例病例及6例死亡,其中,該國中北部聖馬丁大區報告約3,000例病例,該國北部皮烏拉省報告逾560例病例,尚無死亡病例。
qka4XggefJqyqzeRk7T_0w.en: Ecuador epidemic update: In 2024, Ecuador reported more than 60,000 cases and 76 deaths, higher than the 20,000+ cases reported in 2023. So far this year, cases are concentrated in Napo Province in the central region (899) and Orellana Province in the east (626). Peru epidemic update: So far this year, Peru has cumulatively reported over 7,800 cases and 6 deaths. The San Martín region in the north-central part of the country reported about 3,000 cases, and Piura Province in the north reported over 560 cases; no deaths have been reported.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.

KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年1-9月累計1萬餘例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共9國報告病例,分別為巴西(8,258)、秘魯(936)、古巴(555)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)及蓋亞那(2),另美國(90)及加拿大(2)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例。
KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.en: Americas update: From January to September this year, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both in Brazil. A total of 9 countries reported cases: Brazil (8,258), Peru (936), Cuba (555), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2) and Guyana (2). The United States (90) and Canada (2) also reported cases, all of them imported.
